intro: Clear costs. Shared opportunities. Your approval.
failed: Unable to sign in. Check your credentials and try again.
unavailable: The workspace is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
noMembership: No workspace has been assigned to this account.
noNeeds: No replenishment needs yet. Confirm a stock record or state a need to begin.
pricesHidden: Prices are hidden for this staff account.
likeForLike: Same quantity, specification, delivery and credit constraints.
noBaseline: No comparable historical baseline is available.
feeUnverified: No accepted observed-fee rule. The supplier agreement is used.
unavailableQuote: This quote is unavailable for this need. Review its terms and validity.
needMoreData: A valid option needs current stock, usage, capacity and complete supplier terms.
repeatAssumption: Assumes the same confirmed terms for equivalent smaller repeat orders.
refreshRequired: This need or its inputs may have changed. Refresh and review before trying again.
noConfirmedQuote: The stated quantity fits your constraints. Compatible quotes are still needed.
poolExplanation: Find a pool for your selected quantity. Every business must benefit and approve its own order.
noPool: No eligible pool meets the confirmed requirements. You can continue with the solo quotes.
pool_ineligible: Pool is not eligible for release
poolNeedsReview: This offer needs a current review before an order can proceed.
poolNoOrder: Your selected quantity is reserved. No purchase order has been issued.
poolSearchReview: This search needs review for the small demo. You can continue with the solo quotes.
approval_void: Your previous approval is void. Fresh consent is required.
approval_released: Your approval was used for the issued order
capExceeded: The current decision cost exceeds your saved cap.
boundTermsChanged: The approved quantity, specification or supplier terms changed.
approvalScope: Approve your displayed quantity and supplier terms up to your cap. Changed terms require fresh consent. Approval alone creates no order.
approvalInvalid: The cap must cover the decision cost. Expiry must be after now and no later than the offer deadline.
simulationExplanation: Demo output only. No order is sent to a supplier.
taskNotApproval: Completing a task does not approve a record, rule or order.
taskNeedsReview: Processing needs review. This status does not confirm an action.
sourceRestricted: This account cannot view price-bearing sources.
evidenceUnavailable: The evidence anchor does not match this source.
drawMask: Drag across the sensitive region to mask it.
approximateRegion: Approximate region · verify against the full page
fullPageFallback: Exact bounds are unavailable; the full page is shown.
sourceOriginalOnly: Only the original is available for this older source.
maskingExplanation: Review sensitive fields before continuing. Known text patterns are masked automatically; image/PDF regions need your review. This does not confirm a record.
sensitiveValues: Other sensitive text values (one per line)
reviewedMasking: I reviewed this source and selected the sensitive regions or values to mask.
sourcePrepared: Source prepared. Extraction is queued; no record has been confirmed.
sourcePrepareFailed: Preparation could not finish. Check the source and masking selection, then try again.
sourceLimits: PNG, JPEG or PDF up to 10 MB and 10 pages; UTF-8 text up to 16,000 characters.
sourceText: Or paste invoice, stock or supplier text
chooseSource: Choose one file or paste text.
sourceUploadFailed: Upload could not finish. Check the file type and limits, then try again.

records.blankMeansUnknown: Leave unknown values blank. Save corrections before confirming; amounts are never filled with zero automatically.
records.chooseType: Choose purchase or stock for manual review.
records.mappingExplanation: Select an existing confirmed mapping. Unmapped invoice items can be saved as incomplete records. New mappings require owner confirmation separately.
records.usageExplanation: Reported usage is a claim for review. Confirming this stock record does not install a replenishment rule.
records.reviewUnavailable: Record review could not finish. Refresh this source and try again.
records.ownerRequired: Owner review is required: the value is unknown, inconsistent or above the staff limit.
records.stale: This record or its context changed. Refresh and review the latest revision.
records.invalid: Review the required fields, decimal amounts, supplier, mapping and unresolved flags. Save any corrections before confirming.
records.staleMapping: Review the current supplier and mapping
records.replayReading: Authored synthetic replay. Verify every value against the source before confirming.
records.aiReading: AI reading for human review. Confidence does not establish correctness or permission.
records.originalEvidence: Evidence preserves the original reading, including values corrected in later revisions. Regions may be approximate.
records.noFlags: No unresolved field flags. Verify the source before confirming.
records.invoiceScope: Confirm this purchase record. This does not confirm stock arrival or approve an order.
records.stockScope: Confirm this observed stock record. Replenishment rules and order approval remain separate.
records.staffScope: Staff can confirm only within the business limit. Unknown or inconsistent values require an owner.
records.acknowledge: I checked the source, corrected the fields and reviewed all remaining flags.
records.confirmedScope: Record confirmed. Purchasing permission and supplier Send remain separate actions.
records.rejectedScope: Proposal rejected. No accepted record was created from this proposal.
records.replayMiss: No exact replay is available for this prepared source. Reading stopped; no live model was called. Prepare the declared fixture or supply the matching replay before retrying.
records.readingFailed: Reading failed. Review the source and retry when the reading service is ready. No record was confirmed.
records.quoteContext: This is a supplier reply. Select its supplier and item in the quote review flow; it is not an invoice or stock record.
records.manualReview: Reading completed. Refresh to review the saved proposal.
records.readingPending: Reading prepared source… No record is confirmed automatically.
records.calculatedTotal: Calculated total · only with complete charges
